items.stem: In health informatics, FHIR is best described as a:

options.text: Standard for exchanging healthcare information electronically
options.rationale: Correct: FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) is an interoperability standard.
FHIR is a data-exchange standard, not a diagnostic tool.
FHIR is a standard, not hardware.
FHIR concerns interoperable data exchange, not billing settlement.

items.stem: Which TWO are recognised dimensions of health data quality? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: completeness is a core data-quality dimension.
Correct: accuracy is a core data-quality dimension.

options.text: The colour of the dashboard theme
options.rationale: Presentation theme is not a data-quality dimension.

options.text: The brand of the server hardware
options.rationale: Hardware brand is unrelated to data quality.

options.text: The number of staff in the clinic
options.rationale: Staff count is not a data-quality dimension.

items.stem: Removing direct identifiers such as names so that data cannot be readily linked to an individual is called:

options.rationale: Correct: de-identification removes or masks identifiers to limit re-identification.
Duplication copies data; it does not protect identity.
Normalisation is a database-structuring technique, not privacy protection.
Visualisation presents data; it does not protect identity.
